name: Execute the Change — Aubène 2028 and the Hidden Resistance
description: A five-round, advanced change-execution simulation set inside Aubène Assurances SA, a proud 58-year-old French personal-lines insurer (Nantes HQ, 3,200 employees, EUR 1.4bn gross written premiums, a thin 97% combined ratio). The board has funded 'Aubène 2028' — a EUR 60 million, 18-month digital-and-operating-model transformation to defend margins against direct insurers taking ~2 points of share a year. The strategy is sound and funded; three previous transformations still died — not by revolt but by polite compliance, passive delay and a gravitational pull back to the old ways. Surface surveys show 78% 'support', yet the regional branch barons whose informal power the new model erodes are quietly briefing against it. Playing the newly appointed Change Leader, you (1) diagnose the organisation's changeability across structural, behavioural and psychodynamic dimensions and expose the gap between stated and actual readiness the 78% conceals, (2) map the political landscape and surface the hidden resistance — naming the threat to status, identity, competence or control behind each baron's covert opposition and distinguishing noisy-but-harmless dissent from quiet-but-lethal reversion, (3) choose where to intervene with finite time and political capital — co-opt the powerful Division Head, build a front-line coalition, redesign incentives, create early wins or confront blockers — knowing each move has a political cost and a changeability payoff, (4) sequence the 18-month execution against the month-9 board checkpoint, pacing change to the organisation's absorptive capacity so it sticks rather than snaps back, and (5) recover at the checkpoint when the barons' passive resistance has stalled claims digitisation and a board member questions the EUR 60M — re-treating the under-treated root resistance rather than redesigning a sound plan, and re-securing board confidence. The math draws on Jarrett's behavioural-strategy and changeability lens and punishes the five classic errors: trusting the 78%, crushing the Division Head you need, the big-bang launch, intervening only on surface symptoms, and blaming the plan at the checkpoint. Final KPIs track Changeability, Hidden Resistance surfaced, Political Capital and Board Confidence — and whether Aubène 2028 becomes the fourth programme in the graveyard or the one that finally lands.

Execute the Change

On 2 March 2026 the board of Aubène Assurances funded Aubène 2028: €60M and 18 months, with a review at month 9. Three earlier programmes were funded, launched and quietly buried. A survey says 78% of employees support this one. You lead it.

Facilitator (board chair & the room you can't see)
The strategy is not in question: the board, the executive committee and an outside consultancy have signed off on it. What is in question is whether Aubène can change. You have four scores, a survey that says 78% support the programme, and the exit interviews from the three programmes before yours. Decide how much each is worth.

Round-by-Round Record

Changeability vs. the Hidden Resistance

text.en: Diagnose an organization's real change-readiness beneath stated survey support, distinguishing structural, behavioural and psychodynamic constraints
text.es: Diagnosticar la disposición real al cambio de una organización por debajo del apoyo declarado en las encuestas, distinguiendo restricciones estructurales, conductuales y psicodinámicas

text.en: Locate covert resistance by identifying the threat behind it and the actors who hold informal power rather than those who are merely vocal
text.es: Localizar la resistencia encubierta identificando la amenaza que la motiva y a los actores con poder informal, no solo a los que más se hacen oír

text.en: Allocate a finite budget of political capital across competing interventions, including the stance toward a powerful and threatened stakeholder, treating no lever as costless
text.es: Asignar un presupuesto finito de capital político entre intervenciones que compiten, incluida la postura ante un actor poderoso y amenazado, sin tratar ninguna palanca como gratuita

text.en: Design an execution sequence matched to the organization's absorptive capacity, trading the credibility of an early win against the ambition of a broad launch
text.es: Diseñar una secuencia de ejecución ajustada a la capacidad de absorción de la organización, sopesando la credibilidad de una victoria temprana frente a la ambición de un lanzamiento amplio

text.en: Recover a stalling transformation at a funding checkpoint by re-diagnosing execution instead of blaming the strategy or the people
text.es: Reconducir una transformación estancada en un punto de control de la financiación rediagnosticando la ejecución en lugar de culpar a la estrategia o a las personas

name.en: Taking the 78% support survey at face value
name.es: Dar por buena la encuesta del 78 % de apoyo

lure.en: It is the only hard number in the room, and declaring the organization ready lifts board confidence that same round
lure.es: Es el único dato duro disponible, y declarar lista a la organización sube la confianza del consejo esa misma ronda

consequence.en: Changeability falls and hidden resistance rises at once; the misreading keeps costing in Round 2, where a leader who believes the organization is ready finds less of the hidden opposition
consequence.es: La capacidad de cambio baja y la resistencia oculta sube de inmediato; la mala lectura sigue costando en la ronda 2, donde quien cree que la organización está lista encuentra menos oposición oculta

es: encuesta al pie de la letra

source.ref: TN §13 'Trusting the survey (Round 1)'; §7 Q1 likely positions; TN-Exhibit 2 Round 1; §9.2

name.en: Removing the division head to clear the path
name.es: Apartar a la jefa de división para despejar el camino

lure.en: A clean break looks like the fastest route and shows authority at the moment the leader wants to show it
lure.es: Una ruptura limpia parece la vía más rápida y muestra autoridad justo cuando la líder quiere mostrarla

consequence.en: The heaviest rise in resistance and loss of political capital in the model; every other regional manager reads the signal, and the branch network the rollout needs turns uncooperative in Round 4
consequence.es: La mayor subida de resistencia y pérdida de capital político del modelo; los demás directores regionales leen la señal y la red de sucursales que necesita el despliegue deja de cooperar en la ronda 4

es: apartaste a la jefa de división

name.en: Funding visible moves and leaving the barons' concern untouched
name.es: Financiar jugadas visibles y dejar sin tocar la preocupación de los barones

lure.en: Town halls, communications and early wins are safe, visible and cheap in political capital, and they feel like real action
lure.es: Las asambleas, la comunicación y las victorias tempranas son seguras, visibles y baratas en capital político, y dan sensación de acción real

consequence.en: Hidden resistance barely moves; the cost arrives later, when claims digitization stalls before the month-9 checkpoint
consequence.es: La resistencia oculta apenas se mueve; el coste llega después, cuando la digitalización de siniestros se atasca antes del punto de control del mes 9

source.ref: TN §13 'Symptom-only portfolios (Round 3)'; §7 Q3 suggested analysis and likely positions

name.en: Launching the three workstreams at once
name.es: Lanzar los tres frentes de trabajo a la vez

lure.en: Eighteen months is short and a simultaneous launch reads as decisive and ambitious; nobody wants to look slow
lure.es: Dieciocho meses es poco y un lanzamiento simultáneo parece decidido y ambicioso; nadie quiere parecer lento

consequence.en: The organization is overloaded: resistance rises, and political capital and board confidence fall before any win has landed
consequence.es: La organización se sobrecarga: sube la resistencia y bajan el capital político y la confianza del consejo antes de que llegue ninguna victoria

name.en: Blaming the plan at the month-9 checkpoint
name.es: Culpar al plan en el punto de control del mes 9

lure.en: Asking for a strategy rethink is the most sympathetic-sounding answer when something visibly is not working
lure.es: Pedir que se repiense la estrategia es la respuesta que mejor suena cuando algo, a la vista de todos, no funciona

consequence.en: Board confidence drops sharply and the funding can be paused; it repeats the Round 1 error of trusting a stated signal over the organization's real state
consequence.es: La confianza del consejo cae con fuerza y la financiación puede quedar en pausa; repite el error de la ronda 1 de fiarse de una señal declarada y no del estado real de la organización

source.ref: TN §13 'Blaming the plan at the checkpoint (Round 5)'; §7 Q5; §5.5
